sn22.156:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa attānudiṭṭhi uppajjatīti?
sn22.156:1.4: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa attānudiṭṭhi uppajjati.
sn22.156:1.8: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa attānudiṭṭhi uppajjati.
sn22.156:1.12: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ
sn22.156:1.13: api nu taṃ anupādāya attānudiṭṭhi uppajjeyyāti?
